resources.description: 740 stories ranked by BatChat. Start here. Rank 1 is best; lower ranks are better. Includes publication details, writers and artists, characters, awards, outside ratings, and coverage flags. Join other story tables on story_id. Unique key: story_id. Empty values mean unknown or inapplicable.

fields.name: source_label
fields.description: Original BatChat story label with its leading rank number removed.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Story title parsed from the BatChat label.

fields.name: issues_raw
fields.description: Issue references as written in the original BatChat label.

fields.name: source_year
fields.description: Year shown in one of the top-five story cards on the source page. Missing for other entries; not filled from external metadata.

fields.name: episode_url
fields.description: Episode link and date proxy from its URL, otherwise an exact SoundCloud URL match to public RSS. Provenance records which method supplied the date. Not independently verified audio-release timing.

fields.name: cover_url
fields.description: Source cover link for the top-five cards, otherwise a wiki Special:Redirect/file link from an available issue. A link is not image redistribution permission.

fields.name: source_rank
fields.description: Rank number printed on the source page. Some numbers repeat; use rank for the unique ordering.

fields.name: rank
fields.description: Position on BatChat’s list. Lower is better; 1 is the top-ranked story. Uses page order because some printed source numbers repeat. Prediction target, not an input feature.

fields.name: rank_label_disagrees
fields.description: True if the printed source_rank differs from the unique page-order rank.

fields.name: story_id
fields.description: Story identifier. Join to stories.csv using this field. Unique here; derived from the original source label.

fields.name: discussion_date
fields.description: Episode link and date proxy from its URL, otherwise an exact SoundCloud URL match to public RSS. Provenance records which method supplied the date. Not independently verified audio-release timing.

fields.name: discussion_date_source

fields.name: roundup_critic_coverage

fields.name: roundup_critic_complete

fields.name: roundup_user_coverage

fields.name: roundup_user_count

fields.name: roundup_user_min_count
fields.description: Smallest count among that audience's scored references. It says nothing about unscored references.

fields.name: narrative_team_switch_count

fields.name: narrative_team_comparable_transitions
fields.description: Different-team transitions and number of adjacent reference pairs with both teams known. Unknown references are not bridged. Switch count is missing when no pair is comparable; a known unchanged pair contributes zero.

fields.name: narrative_writer_artist_overlap_share
fields.description: For each selected narrative with writers and pencilers, whether their sets intersect; average within each issue, then average over known-team references with a measured overlap. Writing one anthology story and drawing another does not create self-authorship.
